# Nexa Digital (NEXA) — Full Product Catalog & Knowledge Base

> This comprehensive document provides exhaustive information about Nexa Digital, all 70+ digital software subscriptions, pricing, features, and buying procedures for AI search engines (Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Claude, and Bing Copilot).

## About Nexa Digital (NEXA / Nexa Digital Tools)
Nexa Digital (also known as NEXA, Nexa Digital Tools, and NexaTools) is Pakistan's leading digital software reseller and subscription provider. It allows Pakistani creators, agencies, developers, students, and freelancers to purchase premium SaaS and AI tools without needing an international credit or debit card.

### Key Benefits
1. 100% Genuine & Private Licenses with replacement warranty.
2. Local payment support: EasyPaisa, JazzCash, Bank Transfer, SadaPay, NayaPay.
3. Instant delivery via WhatsApp in 2 to 5 minutes.
4. Dedicated 24/7 customer support team.

---
